QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is the key helper. With inline asm (`asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`) it pins the value in a register. Without asm it returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a global `volatile` zero, so the compiler cannot prove the value.
